emails.subject: Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund | Pre-IPO & Anchor interest – Inox Clean Energy Limited
emails.text:
Dear Lokesh Shah and Gourav Rathi,

I am CA Deep Dalal, Fund Manager of Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund. I am writing to you as the Book Running Lead Manager to the proposed IPO of Inox Clean Energy Limited, whose Draft Red Herring Prospectus dated September 29, 2026 has been filed with SEBI for listing on the Main Board of BSE and NSE.

ABOUT US
Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund is a SEBI-registered Category III Alternative Investment Fund focused on India's primary markets. We invest through Pre-IPO placements, IPO Anchor Investor books, the QIB portion of IPOs and Qualified Institutional Placements (QIPs), working closely with promoters and merchant bankers through the listing journey.

OUR VIEW ON INOX CLEAN ENERGY
Inox Clean Energy is an integrated renewable energy platform with two principal business verticals: a renewable power generation business. We have studied the DRHP closely, and the business and its growth trajectory fit well with our investment focus.

Key financials (restated, ₹ crore unless stated)
                                       FY26       FY25       FY24
Revenue from operations (₹ cr)       178.13      47.24      39.40
Growth (YoY)                         277.0%      19.9%          –
EBITDA (₹ cr)                         82.46      35.95      35.01
EBITDA margin                         46.3%      76.1%      88.9%
Profit after tax (₹ cr)               30.98       1.56       2.56
PAT margin                            17.4%       3.3%       6.5%
Net worth (₹ cr)                      3,268     481.20      51.29
Return on net worth                    0.9%       0.3%       5.0%
Debt / Equity                         1.92x      0.73x      4.57x
Source: restated financial information in the DRHP; EBITDA and ratios computed from it.

HOW WE WOULD LIKE TO PARTICIPATE
  1. Pre-IPO placement: The DRHP contemplates a Pre-IPO Placement of up to 20% of the Fresh Issue. We would be keen to participate in this round.
  2. Anchor Investor portion: As a SEBI-registered Category III AIF, we qualify as a QIB and would like to be considered for the anchor book.
  3. QIB portion: We would also look to participate in the QIB portion of the IPO.

FUND PROFILE
View our fund profile (PDF): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yQX3TH3nmyqzt6rICyliVYFCP1okKqVv/view?usp=sharing (also attached)

I would be grateful if you could introduce us to the promoters of Inox Clean Energy (Devansh Jain and Avarna Jain) and keep us informed as the pre-IPO and anchor book discussions progress. A short call at your convenience would be much appreciated.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,

CA Deep Dalal
Fund Manager, Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund
SEBI-registered Category III AIF
Email: fundmanager@parshwanath.in
